notes.content:
There are more updates available.

notes.title: New Clockwork Pussy Update is Launched!
notes.content:
[b]Please UNINSTALL the previous version and INSTALL the new update.[/b] This update was produced on a superior version of the game engine.
We are releasing the latest game update. We advise playing with the [b]keyboard[/b] for a better experience. Please, we are [b]still improving the use of controller support[/b].
The entire structure of the game has been rewritten. There are two and a half levels (yes, because this level will reserve a big surprise for September).

This version is not final. The game will gradually evolve with the help of all of you. We are a small but dedicated team. Please keep communicating with us to improve this game.
This game is yours!

We inserted a new environment,
The player can now drive cars and other vehicles,
Dialogues between player and NPCs,
Fixed some bugs (help us test the game. We don't have a test team as you deserve).
